# HX-UI 2

> React 19 + TypeScript 界面库. 基于 shadcn/ui (Radix + Tailwind v4), 动效用 Motion, 图表用 Recharts, 表格用 TanStack Table v8. 路径别名 "@/" 指向 next/src, "@sites/" 指向 next/sites.

## 写页面的顺序
1. 外壳: 营销页用 `SiteHeader` + 若干 `Section` + `SiteFooter`; 后台 / 面板用 `AppShell` (侧栏 + 顶栏) + `PageHeader`.
2. 区块: 从 `@sites/_blocks/*` 挑整段区块, 数据通过 props 传入, 区块不取数.
3. 细节: 基础件从 `@/components/ui/<name>` 引 (与 shadcn 文档用法一致).
4. 动效: 包一层 `Reveal` / `Stagger` + `StaggerItem` 即可; 数字用 `AnimatedNumber`; 标题用 `TextReveal`.
5. 交互: 需要一个出彩的产品瞬间时, 从 `@/interactions` 挑 (SpeedCounter, StatefulButton ...); 每屏最多一个.

## 区块
- marketing: Hero(title, highlight, description, actions, media, backdrop), Section(eyebrow, title, description), FeatureBento(features[{title, description, icon, visual, span:2|3|4|6}]), LogoCloud(logos), Pricing(plans[{name, description, monthly, yearly, features, cta, featured}]), Testimonials(items[{quote, name, role}]), Faq(items[{q, a}]), Cta(title, description, actions), SiteHeader(brand, links, actions), SiteFooter(brand, columns, note)
- commerce: ProductGallery(media[{src, alt}]), VariantPicker(name, label, options[{value, label, swatch?, soldOut?}], value, onChange), Price(amount, compareAt?, currency?), Rating(value, count?), ProductCard(product), BuyBar(target ref, title, amount, ctaLabel, onBuy)
- dashboard: StatCard(label, value, format?, suffix?, delta?, invert?, trend?, icon?), StatusBoard(services[{name, region, state:"up"|"degraded"|"down"|"maintenance", latencyMs, uptime, history}]), LogStream(lines[{id, time, level, source, message}])
- analytics: ChartCard(title, description, actions, children), Segmented(options, value, onChange)
- shell: AppShell(brand, nav[{label?, items[{id, label, icon, badge?}]}], active, onNavigate, actions, footer), CommandMenu(entries[{id, label, group, icon, onSelect}]), ThemeToggle, PageHeader(title, description, actions)

## 数据
- AreaTrend(data, x, series[{key, label, color?}], stacked?, height?), BarCompare(data, x, series, stacked?, horizontal?), Donut(data[{key, label, value}], centerLabel?), Sparkline(values), DataTable(data, columns: ColumnDef<T>[], searchable?, pageSize?, loading?, onRowClick?)

## 主题
- 包 `ThemeProvider`; `useTheme()` 返回 { mode, resolved, accent, setMode, setAccent }; 强调色 indigo | emerald | rose | amber | zinc.
- 令牌: background, foreground, card, muted, accent, primary, brand, brand-soft, success, warning, destructive, info, chart-1..5, border, ring.

## 交互
- SpeedCounter(value, format?, locale?, duration?): 逐位滚动的数字
- StatefulButton(action: () => Promise, children, pendingLabel?, successLabel?, errorLabel?, resetAfter?): 提交按钮的完整状态流

## 示例
完整页面见 sites/{launch,shop,ops,analytics}/page.tsx.
